observations.fact: Long-hair scalp has two actual mesh islands and a parting vertex group.
Main groom and independent strands are separate native Curves objects bound to a growth mesh.
The 19-curve new hair datablock has no collection users in this file.
observations.implication: Do not count it as a rendered active fine-hair layer.

inferenceForAevrynd: Rebuild editable scalp domains, part controls and separately authored guide flows for the whole crown/perimeter. Small offsets on the old common field did not overcome the cap appearance. Island splitting alone is not a realism guarantee.
